DB.description: D1 database for the EmDash content and the analytics tables. EmDash creates its tables during the setup wizard at `/_emdash/admin`; the analytics plugin creates its own on first use. On **Workers Free**, set the analytics capacity profile to **Small** (Analytics, Settings, Data and capacity); the default, Standard, is sized for Workers Paid.

MEDIA.description: R2 bucket for media uploaded in the EmDash admin.

EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts secret settings such as the Google Search Console and Bing sign-in values. Generate one with `npx emdash secrets generate` (it starts with `emdash_enc_v1_`) and keep a backup: a lost key makes stored secrets unreadable. You can leave it empty and set it later with `npx wrangler secret put EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY`.
